title: Time bound for a prepared verifier call
statement: Let $M_V$ be a finite Turing machine deciding a language $V$ over Boolean words within time $T_V$, and let $x,s$ be Boolean words. From the canonical seam configuration with $s$ on the designated work tape and input $x$, the buffered composition of the assembly machine with $M_V$ reaches, in some $t\le T_V(|x|+|s|)+2(|x|+|s|)+4$ steps, a halted configuration whose output is the one-symbol word containing the indicator of $x$ concatenated with $s$ belonging to $V$.
replaced:
If a machine $MV$ decides a language $V$ within time $T_v$, then from the
canonical candidate seam with candidate $s$ on input $x$, the buffered
composition of the assembly machine with $MV$ halts within
$T_v(|x| + |s|) + 2(|x| + |s|) + 4$ steps, with single-bit output the indicator
of $x \mathbin{+\!\!+} s \in V$.
